record.question: What is the antidote for benzodiazepine overdose?
record.explanation: Answer D: Flumazenil. Flumazenil competitively antagonizes benzodiazepine binding at the GABA-A receptor; use is cautious because it can precipitate seizures/withdrawal in some patients. Source/context note: Not routine for all overdoses; mixed overdose and dependence increase seizure risk. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK470180/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
